faq.title: Frequently Asked
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before we start building.

timeline.q: How long does a typical project take?
timeline.a: Most web applications ship in 8–16 weeks depending on scope. Mobile apps typically take 12–20 weeks. We use 2-week sprints so you see working software from week 2.

techStack.q: What tech stack do you use?
techStack.a: We're stack-agnostic but specialize in React/Next.js, Node.js, Go, PostgreSQL, AWS/GCP, and Kubernetes. We recommend the right tool for your use case, not the trendiest one.

pricing.q: Do you do fixed-price or time-and-materials?
pricing.a: Both. Fixed-price works for well-scoped MVPs. T&M works better for evolving products. We're transparent about trade-offs upfront.

support.a: All plans include post-launch support. Enterprise plans include dedicated SRE coverage and defined SLAs. We don't disappear after launch.

integrations.q: How do you handle integrations with existing systems?
integrations.a: We specialize in API-first architecture. We've integrated with 200+ third-party systems including Salesforce, SAP, Stripe, Twilio, and custom legacy systems.

security.q: Is my code and data secure?
security.a: Security is non-negotiable. All projects include HTTPS/TLS, secrets management, dependency scanning, and OWASP compliance checks. Enterprise projects include penetration testing.

revisions.q: What happens if I'm not happy with the work?
revisions.a: We offer sprint-by-sprint delivery so you can course-correct early. If output doesn't meet agreed specs, we fix it at no cost. We have a 99.9% client satisfaction rate.

ownership.q: Who owns the code after the project?
ownership.a: You do. 100%. All IP is transferred to you upon final payment. We include detailed documentation so your team can maintain and extend the codebase independently.
